summary.content:
Today's selection covers 77 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI is preparing “o,” an always-on ChatGPT assistant that could handle email
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 13 articles published in the last 24 hours
